nodes.name: Send Call Summary
nodes.notes: Set CALLFLOW_SUMMARY_WEBHOOK_URL to a CRM, Make.com, Zapier, or internal analytics webhook.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'handoff.requested', priority: 'high', queue: $env.CALLFLOW_HANDOFF_QUEUE || 'sales-and-support', session_id: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.session_id, call_sid: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.call_sid, caller: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.caller, intent: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.intent, reason: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.handoff_reason, summary: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.summary, recording_url: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.recording_url, requested_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Notify Handoff Team
nodes.notes: Set CALLFLOW_HANDOFF_WEBHOOK_URL to Slack, Teams, your help desk, or a Make/Zapier catch hook.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { accepted: true, session_id: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.session_id, handoff_notified: $('Normalize Call Event').item.json.handoff_required } }}
